permitted.destination: UGENCE_STUDIO_REVIEW_SERVICE_URL: the governed runtime worker's private TLS listener
permitted.condition: only while the variable is set; unset, the review screens report a typed gap and the profile makes no outbound connection
permitted.forwarded_header: X-Ugence-Approver-Proof on POST /review/decisions only, verbatim, never parsed, logged or persisted (ID-1)

external_network_egress.container_gate_note: the container gate runs with the variable unset, so its egress evidence records no outbound connection; the relay's egress is exercised in the deployment suite against a loopback stand-in

frozen.served_api: create_combined_app: governance_studio.api.v1 with governance_studio.api.v2 mounted behind it (CR-2)
frozen.openapi_v2_amendment: v2-A1 (FD-9.4, 2026-09-06): previous dd63180dc91ba7842dc1dc2b6efb3dbc155ea3bd47200f40de7bac85d373f39a; record apps/ugence-governance-studio/contracts/openapi_v2.amendments.json; operations added v2_registry_register, v2_registry_list

configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_REVIEW_SERVICE_URL: optional; read by DeploymentConfig and handed to build_studio_context(review_service_base_url=...) and nowhere else
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY_PATH: optional; read by DeploymentConfig and handed to build_studio_context(activation_root=...) and nowhere else; an absolute sqlite file path under the writable runtime volume (front-door seam 1, FD-5)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID: optional; the one tenant the Authority screen displays; required with UGENCE_STUDIO_POLICY_IDENTITIES; typed (NFC, no whitespace); read by DeploymentConfig only (front-door seam 2, FD-6)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_POLICY_IDENTITIES: optional; comma-separated typed policy identities '<policy_family>|<policy_id>|<scope>' (each NFC, no whitespace, no duplicates; no discovery, no default); requires UGENCE_STUDIO_CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY_PATH and UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID; handed to build_studio_context(policy_registry=..., policy_identities=...) and nowhere else (front-door seam 2, FD-6)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_SIMULATION_PROVIDER: optional; exactly '1' enables the one pinned in-image simulation provider handed to build_studio_context(provider_registry=...) and nowhere else; unset leaves the Simulate screen on its typed gap simulation_providers; any other value is refused before bind (front-door seam 3, FD-7)
configuration_added.UGENCE_STUDIO_SYSTEM_REGISTRY_PATH: optional; an absolute sqlite file path under the writable runtime volume; the tenant-bound system registry (ai-system-registry 0.2.0 SqliteSystemRegistry) handed to build_studio_context(system_registry=..., registered_by=<deployment name/version>) and nowhere else; requires UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID (front-door seam 5, FD-9)

constitution_registry.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-5 SCREEN_1_ONLY (activation root)
constitution_registry.store: SqlitePolicyRegistry (policy-authority Posture B) at UGENCE_STUDIO_CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY_PATH, a file under the writable runtime volume /var/run/ugence-studio
constitution_registry.durability: that of the runtime volume's mount; the prohibited persistent_database (an external database server, driver or DSN) stands: no server, no driver, no DSN
constitution_registry.trust: the constitution authority's DenyAllSignatureVerifier and DenyAllApprovalVerifier and a signer that refuses every act; no key material, no trust anchor, no credential in the image or the container
constitution_registry.reachable_acts: preflight only (mutation-free) through the activation root; read-only, tenant-bound authority reads (issued records for configured identities, one record by id, its revocations and supersessions) through ReadOnlyTenantBoundRegistry over the same registry instance; issuance, revocation, supersession and activation have no route and refuse if invoked
constitution_registry.unset: the Constitution screen reports the typed gap constitution_preflight (available false)

front_door_seams.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP; FD-5 seam 1; FD-6 seam 2; FD-7 seam 3; FD-9 seam 5
handed_to_build_studio_context: policy_registry (seam 2: read-only, tenant-bound view of the seam-1 registry)
provider_registry (seam 3: the one pinned in-image no-I/O simulation provider, only while UGENCE_STUDIO_SIMULATION_PROVIDER=1)
system_registry (seam 5: the tenant-bound SqliteSystemRegistry file under the runtime volume, with registered_by = this deployment's name and version)
absent_by_ruling: decision_store (no durable Decision Authority record store exists; the decision read keeps its typed gap decision_authority_store)
governance_hook (seam 3, FD-7.3 RUNTIME_DEFAULT_BLOCK: the runtime's fail-closed default applies; FD-7.5: a permissive hook is prohibited and refused before bind)
front_door_seams.tenant_binding: records of any tenant other than UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID are refused with a typed refusal and never displayed
front_door_seams.persistent_database: prohibition stands: the registry is the seam-1 sqlite file under the runtime volume; no server, no driver, no DSN

prohibited_definitions.agent_execution: agent execution against any non-fixture provider (FD-7.1 FIXTURE_RUN_ADMISSIBLE, ruled 2026-09-06): a run whose every provider is the in-image no-I/O simulation provider, under DRY_RUN, SIMULATION or SHADOW, is a demonstration and not agent execution; LIVE is absent from the mode list and refused by the studio; external_model_calls and external_tool_calls stand unchanged

simulation.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-7.1 FIXTURE_RUN_ADMISSIBLE, FD-7.2 P3E_IN_PROCESS, FD-7.3 RUNTIME_DEFAULT_BLOCK, FD-7.4 ONE_PINNED_FIXTURE_PROVIDER, FD-7.5 PROHIBITED_IN_PROFILE

provider.behaviour: records each invocation in memory and returns success; opens no socket, reads no file, spawns nothing, holds no credential

simulation.registry: ProviderRegistry holding exactly that one provider, built in-process by build_simulation_registry(); no provider list is read from the environment (FD-4: no discovery, no default)
simulation.governance_hook: absent by ruling (FD-7.3): the runtime's own UnconfiguredGovernanceHook applies, so every consequential task BLOCKs with GOVERNANCE_NOT_CONFIGURED and the trace shows it; governance_hook_configured is false in every answer
simulation.permissive_hook: prohibited (FD-7.5): the composition root refuses any hook handed to the Simulate service before bind (refuse_permissive_hook) and startup integrity fails if this package's source could construct one (simulation_no_permissive_hook); governance_hook_permissive is false in every answer
simulation.live: absent from the mode list and refused by the studio with a typed 422
simulation.unset: the Simulate screen reports the typed gap simulation_providers (available false)
simulation.composition_record: composition-record.json (an ai-system-registry SystemRegistration, FD-3), superseding the seam-2 record kept byte-for-byte as composition-record.seam-2.json

system_registry.ruling: ADR_UGENCE_STUDIO_FRONT_DOOR_SCOPING.md FD-9.1 SCREEN_1_TYPED_REGISTRATION, FD-9.2 LOCAL_SQLITE_UNDER_RUNTIME_VOLUME, FD-9.3 OWNER_REF_PRESENTED_UNPROVEN, FD-9.4 V2_AMENDMENT_TWO_OPERATIONS, FD-9.5 REGISTER_IS_THE_ONLY_WRITE
system_registry.store: SqliteSystemRegistry (ai-system-registry 0.2.0) at UGENCE_STUDIO_SYSTEM_REGISTRY_PATH, a file under the writable runtime volume /var/run/ugence-studio; no server, no driver, no DSN, no network
system_registry.durability: that of the runtime volume's mount; the prohibited persistent_database (an external database server, driver or DSN) stands
system_registry.tenant_binding: the file is bound to UGENCE_STUDIO_TENANT_ID at first open and never re-bound; a file bound to another tenant is refused before bind; a read or write for another tenant is a typed refusal, never an empty answer
system_registry.registrant: owner_ref is a typed opaque handle recorded as PRESENTED_UNPROVEN; registered_by is this deployment's name and version; no identity is claimed until an issuer exists (AI-C)
system_registry.reachable_acts: register (the only write: append-only, a duplicate derived id refused, an inadmissible supersession refused by supersession_refusals) and the tenant's registrations in force at an instant; no edit, revocation, gate, admission, promotion or attestation has a route; a registration confers no approval, maturity, authority or permission (registry ADR D-5)
system_registry.contract: v2_registry_register and v2_registry_list, the first amendment of the frozen v2 contract, recorded in frozen.openapi_v2_amendment
system_registry.unset: the Registration screen reports the typed gap system_registry (available false)
system_registry.composition_record: composition-record.json (an ai-system-registry SystemRegistration, FD-3), superseding the seam-3 record kept byte-for-byte as composition-record.seam-3.json
